verdict.rationale: Gecko documents scanning source code across many languages with compiler-accurate cross-file analysis. Each finding carries a source-to-sink call chain, severity, proof of concept and patch, so it is a static vulnerability scanner for this story. Hands-on reports note false positives and missed issues, which lowers confidence but does not contradict that the scanning exists. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the vulnerability classes detected (injection, XSS), a published rule or class catalog, and independent corroboration of detection accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run static analysis that finds vulnerability classes like injection and XSS in my source code

citations.quote: Each finding includes a severity (CVSS 4.0), a confidence score, the full source-to-sink call chain, a proof of concept, and a suggested patch.
